name: Greater Affix Balloon (Combat)
body:
You can make free attacks on foes that you send floating away with your balloons.

Prerequisite(s): Haan, Int 13, Affix Balloon or balloon special ability, Combat Expertise, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): You receive a +2 bonus on checks made to affix a balloon to a foe. Whenever you successfully move an opponent with a balloon, that forced movement provokes attacks of opportunity.
